description: This PHP class 'ImageAttachmentController' handles HTTP requests to fetch and serve theme-related images (client logo, banner, login banner) within the OrangeHRM application's Corporate Branding plugin. It extends an abstract file controller and utilizes traits to access theme services, processing image requests and returning image content through HTTP responses.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling image attachment requests related to theme images within the Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to retrieve and serve the specified theme image if it exists, otherwise returns a bad request response.
